entries.27238fb5b72e6cea: This business designs and plans in-house, and sells, baby and children's clothing and apparel goods. In Japan, it mainly sells directly to consumers through online retail, and also operates in-shops at some department stores. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥293 million.
entries.5f3967bab90e57a5: A Kobe-based company whose main businesses are real estate leasing and renovation resale, and which also sells baby and children's clothing and provides a kindergarten child monitoring service.
entries.6f0581030b78a11b: This business uses wearable IoT technology to provide a child-monitoring service to childcare facilities nationwide, which watches over infants during afternoon naps and checks for changes in physical condition. It also sells heatstroke prevention products. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥38 million.
entries.90cc3de0035c4b3b: Investors in small-unit real estate products
entries.a3828f41e111ac8f: This business leases and manages real estate and sells used properties whose value has been enhanced through renovation. It is carried out by KIMURATAN Estate Corporation, KIMURATAN Property Corporation, Isto Group, Kyuken Kizai Co., Ltd., SwanStyle Co., Ltd. and others, and it also conducts specified joint real estate businesses. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥2,200 million.
entries.a91cedbcf42e77ae: The company is headquartered in Chuo-ku, Kobe, and carries on three businesses: the Real Estate Business, the Apparel Business and the Wearable Business. It has nine consolidated subsidiaries; revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥2,533 million, and it had 34 employees as of March 31, 2026.
